## Unmet Requirements

The following requirements have no test citing them by ID.
They may be covered by unlabelled tests or by design decisions.

- **CR-03**: Collect only the data needed; consent flag is recorded
  - Reason: 14-field schema and consent flag verified in test_all_schema_cases and test_V02_firing_on_consent_false.
- **DR-01**: No real personal data anywhere in the repository
  - Reason: No real personal data; verified by test_protected_store_isolation.py and tools/check_docs.py secrets scan.
- **FR-06**: Recommend an amount and an interest band for ELIGIBLE decisions
  - Reason: Covered by golden test vectors test_calculations_tv.py (offer amounts and bands for TV1-TV5, TV9).
- **FR-18**: Compare engine and oracle on D1; differences are zero
  - Reason: Independent reference oracle comparison verified by tools/oracle_diff.py (0 differences).
- **FR-19**: Batch evaluation on D2 and D3 without audit writes
  - Reason: Batch evaluation on D2/D3 verified via make decide-d2 and make decide-d3 without audit writes.
- **FR-24**: Edge-case evaluation covers categories MD, TB, TF, RC, AD
  - Reason: Edge-case suite covers MD, TB, TF, RC, AD categories in reports/edge_cases/summary.md.
- **NFR-04**: All policy thresholds are in params/params.toml (no magic numbers in code)
  - Reason: Policy thresholds loaded from params/params.toml; verified by test_param_loader.py and tools/check_floats.py.
- **NFR-05**: Rules are TOML data; no rule logic is generated by hand
  - Reason: Rules stored as declarative TOML data; verified by test_rule_loader.py and make check-rules.
- **NFR-06**: Audit log is append-only
  - Reason: Append-only audit log enforced by SQLite triggers; verified in test_fr15_nfr02_audit_records_and_immutable_triggers.
